pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions exhibit polygonal geometries with sharp edge gradients. Patches on the upper neck and dorsal flank are larger in area, while those on the lower flank show reduced spatial scale and increased edge angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space creates a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are located at the vertices of the polygonal patches. Corridor width is narrow and consistent across the primary field of view.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal ridge displays a distinct, high-frequency jagged profile with low amplitude, corresponding to the mane's alignment along the upper neck against the background.
